data.content_ref: inline:The claim that decentralized networks are more resilient via heterogeneity (SRC_005) contradicts the 'latent synchronization' mechanism (SRC_003) if the infrastructure layer is homogeneous. Specifically, the resilience benefit of heterogeneity is refuted if the diversity of the service layer is rendered irrelevant by a shared dependency on a common substrate (e.g., a single cloud provider's DNS), which transforms the decentralized topology into a virtual monolith.
